column1: # Primers for mFAST-SeqS, transcribed verbatim from Verschoor et al. 2023
# LINE-1 PCR (PCR1): amplifies LINE-1 loci genome-wide from cfDNA.
# Index PCR (PCR2): adds Illumina P5/P7 adapters + sample indices, primed
# off the common tail introduced by the LINE-1 PCR primers.
# All 8 forward primers share the same right-anchored 18nt LINE-1-specific
# sequence, after stripping the common 5' adapter tail, ends in this exact
# string). The preceding bases (0-8nt, increasing per row) are the
# heterogeneity/frameshifting spacer used to diversify the first several
# sequenced bases across the pooled library for the Fadrosh et al. 2014
# dual-indexing scheme - this is what config.yaml's primer.forward_seq
# (the bare 18nt core) and cutadapt's non-anchored -g search are built to
# strip regardless of which spacer length a given read carries.
